ADMIN_PUBKEY.description: The administrator's Nostr **public** key as 64 lowercase hex characters, not an `npub`. Only this key can sign in to the Admin UI at `/admin`, through a NIP-07 browser signer. Never give Signflare the administrator's private key. [Find or convert your key](https://github.com/SnowCait/signflare#admin_pubkey).

MASTER_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Secret root key material that encrypts registered identity private keys at rest. Use a new random value of at least 32 bytes, such as the output of `openssl rand -hex 32`: Signflare uses its exact text as key material. If it is lost or changed, stored identities can no longer be decrypted. [Details](https://github.com/SnowCait/signflare#generate-the-secrets).

REMOTE_SIGNER_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Secret Nostr private key (64-character hex or `nsec`) of this deployment's NIP-46 remote signer, which protects NIP-46 transport for every identity. Generate a new valid key for this purpose only, never the administrator's key or a registered identity's key. [How to generate one](https://github.com/SnowCait/signflare#generate-the-secrets).
